newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Fahey says 96/7 GDP target could be at risk.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Fahey says 96/7 GDP target could be at risk.

text.p: Australian finance minister John Fahey said the government's 3.5 percent economic growth forecast for 1996/97 could be at risk if the Senate continued to block revenue measures.
Asked by reporters if the growth target was still achievable, Fahey said; "I do, again this could be a problem if the Senate knocks around the savings which are in the strategy generally."

"The Democrats (a minority party) and the cross-benches in the Senate have the capacity to completely destroy the budget strategy which has brought lower interest rates, it has brought back business confidence," he said.
"And that therefore threatens the sustainable growth which I believe the government is on target with its contribution to allow the economy to achieve next year," Fahey said.
